constraints.name: adjacent_sum_perfect_square
constraints.description: In a squareful permutation, the sum of every pair of adjacent elements must be a perfect square.
constraints.formal: For a permutation p of length n, ∀i ∈ [1, n-1], p[i] + p[i+1] ∈ {k² | k ∈ ℤ}

constraints.name: permutation_identity_by_value
constraints.description: Two permutations are considered distinct if and only if there is some index where the values differ; permutations with identical value sequences are counted as one, regardless of original element indices.
